sample_steps.description: Start from all rows in the deposited Study 3 file.

Exclude participants failing basic attention checks (article; prereg). Whether the file contains failing rows is unstated. D33 lists four check columns: attn_afterscen (post-scenario, options 1-5 correspond to the four cells plus 'do not remember'), comp1 (who Alex is), comp2 (nature of problem), comp3 (whether Alex has a history of creating conflicts; 1 = false, 2 = true). Inferred pass rule: attn_afterscen consistent with cond_num (1 loyal/control-history, 2 loyal/divisive, 3 control/control-history, 4 control/divisive), comp1 consistent with cond_rel, comp2 == 2, comp3 == 2 if divisive else 1. Which checks were enforced is unstated.
